description:
Get one motion entry as a build prompt: what moves and how (every property, duration, easing
or spring, delay and trigger), why it feels good, how to adapt it to another size, the
accessibility it needs, Screenrove's vanilla HTML/CSS/JS and the original source where its
license allows. Values are marked exact (code) or approximate (a recording). Keep the timings;
scale distances to your element as the prompt says; translate the code to your stack.

code.description: Which code to include - both, vanilla (Screenrove rebuild), original (source library) or none.

motionId.description: Motion entry id from search_motion, e.g. interior-copy-button.

name: get_motion
title: Get one animation with its spec and code
